## Problem

What are you unable to do today? Describe the problem, not your preferred solution.

## Why it belongs here

How does this fit the project's stated scope and constraints?

## What it would break

Constraints it pressures, and what you would give up to get it.

## Alternatives

What you considered, and why they fall short.
